content_sections.heading: IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Important Dates
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates should apply online latest by the date given below. Applications sent through any other mode will not be entertained.

rows.event: IFFCO AGT Last Date to apply online

content_sections.heading: IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Four Years B.Sc. (Agriculture) Full-Time Regular Degree from a University/Institute recognized by the UGC/AICTE. Candidates who have a CGPA score must convert it into a percentage while filling the application form. Candidates must be well versed in reading, writing, and speaking the regional language of the State for which the application is made. Knowledge of more than one language will be an added advantage, and knowledge of Hindi is desirable.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 30 years, as on 01st September 2026 . Age is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and by 3 years for OBC candidates not belonging to the creamy layer.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: As per the rules of the organization, the stipend presently payable during the one-year training period is Rs. 33,300/- per month . On successful completion of one year's training, and subject to the requirement of IFFCO, Agriculture Graduate Trainees may be absorbed at a basic pay of Rs. 37,000/- per month , in the regular Pay Scale of Rs. 37,000 – 70,000/- , along with allowances/benefits as per the rules of the organization.

content_sections.heading: IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Preliminary On-Line Test: Eligible candidates will be required to appear for a preliminary Computer Based On-Line Test in an open environment, using their own resources (computer/laptop with internet facility). Final On-Line Test: Candidates shortlisted based on their performance in the Preliminary On-Line Test will be called for a Final On-Line Test in a controlled environment, at designated centres. Personal Interview and Medical Examination: Candidates shortlisted after the Personal Interview will be medically examined as per IFFCO's medical standards before final selection. IFFCO management reserves the right to make any change in the selection procedure, based on the number of applications received.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: IFFCO AGT Apply Online process is entirely online; applications sent through any other mode will not be entertained. Visit the official application link: https://careers.iffco-recruitments.in/jobs/agriculture-graduate-trainee-2026 . Register and fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and category details. If your B.Sc. (Agriculture) degree result is in CGPA, convert it into a percentage before filling the marks details in the application form. Submit the completed online application on or before the last date, 14.10.2026 . Keep a printout/copy of the submitted application for future reference, including for the Preliminary and Final On-Line Tests.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post available under IFFCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IFFCO has invited online applications for the post of Agriculture Graduate Trainee (AGT).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a four-year full-time regular B.Sc. (Agriculture) degree from a UGC/AICTE-recognized University or Institute.

faq.question: Q4. What minimum marks are required for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates need at least 60% aggregate marks, while SC/ST candidates need at least 55% aggregate marks in B.Sc. (Agriculture).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on 01 September 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for eligible SC/ST and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend during IFFCO AGT training?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a stipend of Rs. 33,300 per month during the one-year training period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary after completing IFFCO AGT training?
faq.answer: On successful completion of training and subject to IFFCO's requirement, AGTs may be absorbed at a basic pay of Rs. 37,000 per month in the pay scale of Rs. 37,000–70,000.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Preliminary Online Test, Final Online Test, Personal Interview and Medical Examination.
